title: [elegance] PeerHealthState::select_peer() conflates selection with state mutation
description: select_peer() both finds eligible peers AND advances rr_index (line 115 in relay_health.rs). This violates separation of concerns. Callers must follow up with record_attempt() (relay_queue.rs:225), and if they forget, round-robin state advances without a logged attempt. Separate the immutable selection logic from the mutable state advancement, or use an RAII guard that enforces explicit acknowledgment.
